_doc: Radio and teletype lines (PLAN M4: the raid story). Each pool is a list of lines; one is picked by the event's own numbers (same game, same words). {where} = grid square, {n} = how many, {what} = the thing hit, {stage} = nest stage. M11 gives them voices; every line is also printed on the teletype. Skitterkin only (other families add pools later).

raidForming.text: Movement at the nest near {where}. They are gathering. Heading for the {what}.
Nest at {where} is stirring — a party is forming. Looks like they want the {what}.
Chittering from {where}. Something has them riled. Plotting their line to the {what} now.

raidSpotted.text: Contact! {n} of them in sight at {where}.
Eyes on the raid, {where}. I count {n}.
Raid in sight at {where}. {n} on the scope. All posts stand to.

raidAtWall.text: They are on the wall at {where}! Chewing at it.
Wall under attack at {where}. Hold them there.

wallBreached.text: Breach! The wall is down at {where}.
They are through the wall at {where}!

buildingLost.text: The {what} at {where} is gone. Crews are clear.

convoyHit.text: Carriers hit on the road at {where}. They have dropped their load.

raidBeaten.text: That is the last of them. Raid beaten.
All clear. The raid is broken.

raidWithdrew.text: They are pulling back toward the nest at {where}.

hqHit.text: The headquarters is under attack! Everything to the bunker!
They are at the bunker doors. Hold the HQ.

nestBudded.text: A new nest has budded off near {where}.

nestCleared.text: Nest at {where} destroyed. Crews are lifting a core sample.

ringClosed.text: Ring closed. The wall is tight from end to end.

gameOver.text: The headquarters has fallen. All stations, this is the end of the line.

crippled.text: The headquarters is crippled. We are blind and slow until the crews patch it up.
